title: Sentence (0.2)
description: One JSONL line per sentence (K-12). Language-neutral: the engine blanks declared cloze targets or plays the sentence for dictation; it never parses the language itself. Audio is media-first (`media/<id>.wav`) with model-output synthesis fallback. Each `cloze_targets` entry must occur verbatim in `text` (enforced at load).

text.description: Canonical written sentence; the dictation answer and the cloze host.

reading.description: Optional phonetic reading (shown only after grading, never during a cloze or dictation attempt).

gloss.description: Meaning in the pack's metalanguage; shown for cloze context hints only after grading.

cloze_targets.description: Substrings of `text` the learner types from context. The engine blanks one deterministically; the target is never visible during the attempt.
